mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50k over two consecutive months indicates weakening labor market demand, reducing corporate hiring and profit expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.4 million units per month signals strong household demand and confidence, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, reducing corporate capacity utilization and profit margins, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both consumer spending (RSAFS) and residential construction (HOUST) signals a broad-based demand surge, increasing corporate revenue visibility and equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stagnant or declining federal funds rate signals a lagging monetary policy response, increasing real rate uncertainty and equity risk premiums, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS unchanged or falling
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% and a rise in non-farm payroll growth above 150k signals a tight labor market with strong hiring momentum, increasing wage pressures and corporate cost expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 2-year window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized growth, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3.0%), signals a healthy, non-inflationary growth environment that supports elevated equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
